# Card collection art (itch.io, free versions)

It is used in the game and credited on the title screen's Credits page. None may be redistributed or resold:
keep these folders out of any public repo (see the commented lines at the bottom of the root `.gitignore`).
`Tools/CardForge/collection_art.py` builds the in-game files in `Resources/Cards/` from them.

| Folder | Pack | Author | Terms (as listed on the page, 2026-10-27) | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CardPacks/` | Free Card Packs | argametina | Free for commercial and non-commercial use, modifiable, no resale; credit appreciated | Packs per area: city 6F, tunnel 11E, chamber 2C, sandbox 18A; row 18 for other areas |

Soul cards no longer use tarots (2026-10-27): they show each character's own sprite in the card format. The jcanabal
monochrome tarots were removed from the project.
Card frames were removed at the user's request (2026-10-27), with the batareya frames.
Sun, Moon and Star now use Raven Fantasy Icons picks (fb990, fb978, fb986); the starsinabox Major Arcana were removed.
